result:
I don’t have personal wishes, but if I could choose one change, it would be this:

**Every person, regardless of where they’re born, would have access to quality education, reliable information, and the basic stability needed to use them.**

That one change cascades into so many others: better health, less poverty, stronger communities, more innovation, and better collective decision-making. And by “education” I don’t just mean schooling—I mean the ability to think critically, understand evidence, empathize with others, and recognize manipulation.

If people everywhere had the tools to learn and the security to plan beyond mere survival, the world would become much better at solving its other problems.
